name: scheduling
deprecation_criterion: Superseded when scheduling moves to a different clock source (e.g. a native plugin cron API) or when the tick interval/route become config-driven and this slice's hardcoding is removed.
spec_change_reason: The /auto-maintainer:start (v0.6.0) and /auto-maintainer:tick (v0.9.0) shipped SKILL.md bodies embed a 'Reading the merge signals' factual observability section so the executor never misreads a paused/async auto-merge as a stuck loop: merged counts IN-TICK merges only; a PR with GitHub auto-merge enabled lands asynchronously and shows merged=0 in the enabling tick (NORMAL, not a block); merged=0 with auto_merge_enabled>0 means N PRs pending GitHub auto-merge (CI/mergeability in flight); async completions surface next tick as RECONCILE auto_merged (reported once); a REAL merge problem is integrate_errored>0 or reconcile_errors>0 (or a RECONCILE-CONFLICTING PR), never merged=0 alone; the counters are read TOGETHER. status.py (v0.4.0) gains an injectable tolerant DEFAULT_OPEN_PR_SOURCE probe surfacing open_loop_prs (list of {number, auto_merge_enabled, merge_state}) that yields [] on any failure and never crashes status, with render_status showing per-PR pending/off lines or 'open loop PRs: none'. Purely additive: existing trace/tick_end counters and the /tick subagent_tokens spend-metering are unchanged. feature.json advanced 0.51.0 -> 0.52.0.
spec_no_change_reason: spec.md was already advanced to 0.52.0 (merge-signal interpretation guidance + status open_loop_prs surfacing) by the dispatcher's spec-update commit ce0c1ce before this TDD cycle; this cycle implements that spec in the two SKILL.md bodies and status.py
